sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Wooden crate is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A 5x3 grid green wooden crate that spawns military loot.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: The padlocked version of this crate is never empty. The lock can be shot off.
